alignment-sanctuary.name: Alignment Sanctuary

operational.targets: One fixed 10-foot-radius, 10-foot-high area centered on suitable approximately horizontal immobile ground or surface within range and line of effect. Your casting class selects Abjuration rank 3 or Shaman Conjuration rank 6; rank-6 Conjuration requires both of your canonical alignment axes explicitly recorded before casting.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. If cast in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; preserve that virtual marker through order changes or departure. If cast outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends.
operational.resolution: Snapshot the caster's actual canonical alignment at application; do not infer it from ancestry, faction, reputation, faith, appearance or conduct. Abjuration rank 3 uses Wisdom saves against your spell DC for opposed entrants. Conjuration rank 6 uses exact matching admission with no save. The snapshot is fixed for this application.
operational.effect: Abjuration rank 3: a creature is opposed if at least one explicitly known axis is exact opposite to the snapshot (Lawful/Chaotic or Good/Evil). Neutral is never opposite; an unknown axis supplies no opposition, and does not erase a known opposite on the other axis. On an opposed creature's attempted entry from outside, roll its Wisdom save before entry, including forced movement, carriage or teleportation. REVIEWED CADENCE CLARIFICATION: record that success or failure for this source character, mode and target until the target's next regular-start marker; the current in-progress start never counts. A success permits entries during that window; failure blocks all non-Falling entry attempts during it without repeat rolls. Same-caster replacement/recasting does not reset this window. Outside initiative, use a fixed 6-second window and preserve its deadline if initiative starts. A failed physical entry stops before the boundary; a failed teleport leaves the creature at its origin without refunding committed teleport costs. Conjuration rank 6: only a creature with both explicit canonical axes exactly matching both snapshotted axes may enter from outside. Unknown is not matching. Nonmatching physical entry, forced movement and carriage stop before entry; a teleport attempt to place a nonmatching creature inside leaves it at origin after costs are committed.
operational.scaling: None. Shaman's preserved Conjuration rank-6 access costs 13 RP before ordinary surcharges; extra RP or character level cannot select another placement.
operational.limitations: Both modes allow existing occupants to remain or leave; once outside, entry restrictions apply. Unsupported ordinary Falling is not arrested, supplies no platform and adds no movement; it can place a creature inside. No AC/save bonus, healing, rest guarantee, resource recovery, attack immunity, concealment, morality compulsion or alignment change. The ward denies entry rather than Actions and does not consume the shared hard-denial ledger. Multiple casters' wards retain independent source permissions and save windows; no single ward's success bypasses another ward. The preserved rank-6 Abjuration aligned-benefits placement has no actual class-access grant and stays unassigned/unavailable; its vague benefits are not imported. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, Abjuration rank-3 opposed-entry Wisdom save and Shaman Conjuration rank-6 same-alignment safe haven. NEW CONFLICT RULINGS: fixed 10-foot-radius/height and concentration 1 minute replace Instantaneous metadata; actual modes stay separate, unassigned rank-6 Abjuration benefits remain blocked. NEW: snapshots, entry/teleport/Falling handling and exact two-axis Conjuration matching. Save-window/recast and rank-6 snapshot-validity completions are jointly reviewed provisional rules.

alignment-essence.name: Alignment Essence

operational.targets: One free hand of yours, or an unoccupied supporting surface you perceive within range, for one sealed single-dose vial.
operational.duration: Unused vial lasts 10 minutes (600 seconds) from creation. Legal whole-dose consumption before that deadline replaces it with a 1-minute visible result on the same empty vial, expiring 60 seconds after consumption. Preserve each actual deadline through initiative changes. No concentration.
operational.resolution: Automatic creation. A creature can spend an Action voluntarily drinking the entire dose. This spell grants no forced-feeding permission and no save. If another exact source legally causes full forced ingestion within one Action, the same resolution applies. Mere external contact does nothing.
operational.effect: After one creature consumes the entire intact dose in that Action, its current actual canonical Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic and Good/Neutral/Evil axes appear as plainly readable symbols on the empty vial for 1 minute. Each unrecorded/unknown axis reads Indeterminate; a known other axis is still reported. This snapshots the actual alignment at consumption, not future changes. The liquid disappears on consumption, while the empty vial remains to show the result and vanishes when that result ends. A viewer must ordinarily see and understand the symbols; the spell grants no remote message or language knowledge. The vial weighs one quarter pound, has AC 10 and 1 HP.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: One vial or result-vial per caster; successful recasting ends the prior one. Splitting, mixing, diluting, sampling or sharing the dose makes all remaining liquid inert and gives no result; inert vial/liquid vanish at the original creation deadline. A broken/destroyed vial ends its remaining dose or result and all conjured matter vanishes. The spell uses actual individual records, not inferred faction/species/ancestry/reputation/disguise/conduct/personality. Explicit protection of alignment information can block/restrict the affected report; display Indeterminate for a protected axis, without identifying the cause or overriding the protection. It reveals no soul state, memory, class, oath validity, intent, crime, secret faction or future morality and neither changes alignment nor compels behavior. No saleable potion, reagent, permanent sample, nutritional supply or crafting matter. This is an HP object, not an Integrity object. Apply only damage/effects whose actual rules can affect this object; no HP/Integrity conversion, automatic creature condition, unstated resistance or immunity is supplied. An effect requiring an organic creature cannot affect it merely because it has HP. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup of an older application cannot end its replacement. A countered cast creates no replacement. Starting a concentration spell still ends the caster's incompatible prior concentration before interruption. Known/prepared access, actual class rank/level, components, line of effect, RP and other costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks direct targeting and originating line of effect. No automatic upcast or level scaling unless this card explicitly prints companion-profile scaling.

Creature-to-creature may affect an unwilling target on a failed Constitution save; while shaping, that target repeats the save at each original regular end and once per numbered round after positive actual HP damage. Creature-to-object requires willingness. Objects make no save. If concentration survives the full shaping minute, the result becomes persistent until dispelled. Use the complete TRANSFORMATION_SPELL_PLAYTEST.md procedure and finite spell_form_profiles.json register. Preflight all targets, anatomy, space and access before committing Action/RP; commit ends your old concentration before counters or saves. A failed or countered new spell does not restore old concentration. An anatomy from another source is replaced only on actual success. No displaced form remains underneath.
operational.effect: Creature transformations retain one identity and one HP/durability history. Creature-to-creature uses any legal R4 or R9 spell-form profile. Creature-to-object creates one inert mundane object anatomy without healing or a new durability pool. Object-to-creature uses the object's existing structural HP as its one durability ledger and creates a controlled no-soul companion using an eligible non-humanoid R4/R9 profile and the caster's snapshotted spell statistics. Object-to-object changes only mundane form/material within the bounded utility restrictions.
operational.scaling: No automatic scaling. Permanent attack/DC values supplied by this spell snapshot the original caster's spell attack, spell DC and M when cast. Snapshot PB and source class as well. All True Polymorph supplied attack/DC values use this snapshot from casting, including shaping.
operational.limitations: No mode creates XP, loot, a soul, resurrection entitlement, valuable material, consumable stock, ammunition, currency, medicine, food or magical properties. Carried, worn, attuned, magical, artifact, structural-terrain and undefined-durability objects are ineligible. Object-origin creatures cannot receive ordinary HP healing as a means of repairing their source object. Only one active object-origin True Polymorph creature per caster is permitted. Such a creature shares the owner's companion Bonus Action/offensive budget and gains no independent turn/resources. Permanent True Polymorph does not end at 0 HP merely to restore the original form. Death/destruction remains real; later dispelling changes anatomy only and never heals, resurrects or recreates missing matter. The subject owns supplied natural-attack events; the original caster supplies attack statistics. These attacks are not spell casts or automatically caster spell-damage/kill triggers. A Druid cannot enter Shapeshift while a spell anatomy is active. Temporary lower-rank spells cannot replace higher-rank anatomy. Only a successful True Polymorph or an exact named exception can replace permanent True anatomy. Antimagic suppresses the same record while concentration and its absolute clock continue; True Polymorph can stabilize while suppressed. Suppression never frees an object-companion slot or resets gear. Creature-origin type tags remain unchanged; profile names confer no creature type. Every supplied attack has5-foot reach. Original anatomical abilities unavailable in the selected profile do not persist underneath it. A successful new transformation closes the old record and atomically restores/recaptures still-existing original gear; internal profile switches instead retain the same meld set and drop incompatible external gear. Mandatory reversion returns at the same anchor; blocked placement is referred to canonical geometry without automatic teleport or crushing damage. Original melded gear remains inaccessible under antimagic. A willing temporary creature-origin recipient can use its regular-turn rejection Action while suppressed if its root creature anatomy can act; object-origin identities gain no rejection right. No generic magical-attack bypass flag is granted. Object origin and earliest physical identity persist through every transformation chain. Object-origin creatures never gain a humanoid profile, soul, ordinary healing, resurrection or biological/class/rest resources. Use one actual structural HP ledger; structural0 destroys the object and ends its creature manifestation. Creature-origin object anatomy is actionless, not automatically Incapacitated. Allowed object templates are barrier/slab, ramp/wedge, open-container, static-furniture or simple-one-piece-tool; no actuated mechanism, magical or valuable output. Output size Tiny..Large and within one category of input; output mass cannot exceed recorded input or earliest origin mass; value cannot exceed original documented ceiling. Corpses/remains, magical/attuned/carried/worn/attended/structural objects and undefined structural durability are ineligible. An object-creature reserves its original caster slot on successful shaping; suppression/control change never frees it. At the60-second boundary finish damage, resolve due repeat save, then stabilize only surviving links. Replacing an active True object anatomy requires legal True replacement, not fresh nonmagical/unattended outside-object admission. Creature-origin people retain their CON save against unwilling creature-profile recasts and must consent to object-profile recasts. Returning them to creature anatomy grants no companion slot.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: True Polymorph identity, Rank 9, exact class access/schools, Action, 120 feet, V/S/F, base 26 RP, creature/object scope and meaningful until-dispelled permanence. NEW: one-minute shaping/stabilization procedure, save/agency rules, bounded form register, object eligibility/size/value rules, object-origin companion contract, one controlled-object-creature cap, durability conservation and destruction/dispel semantics.

alarm.name: Alarm

operational.targets: One fixed 10-foot-radius ground area centered on a point you can perceive within range; choose up to 3 creatures when cast that will not trigger it
operational.duration: 8 hours or until you cast Alarm again
operational.resolution: None.
operational.effect: Ward the chosen area against intrusion. The first time each round a Tiny-or-larger creature not excluded when cast enters the area, the spell produces a brief magical alarm audible to you and creatures within 60 feet of the ward.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: Only one Alarm from this spell may be active for you at a time; recasting ends the previous Alarm. It reports entry only, not identity, intent, alignment, statistics, exact route, or concealed facts. A creature already inside when the spell is cast does not trigger it until it leaves and re-enters. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, and V/S/F components are retained. Core says Instantaneous while the source requires a continuing alarm; 8-hour duration, 10-foot radius, exclusion list, audible trigger, and one-active-alarm cap are NEW provisional specifications.
